topic: Codex re-runs undo host-verified Postgres fixes
lesson: When a follow-up delegate carries a fix Codex cannot reproduce in its sandbox (Postgres-only hang or failure), state in the note that the earlier fixes are accepted and that only the named file may change, with the host-side proof; otherwise Codex reasons the fix away and reverts autoreview-accepted work (JOBPERM-3-T1 run 9).
